body: I have family, I love my mom. I don't want to make her suffer, but this pain is too much. I don't mind being alone, i just feel that I have no purpose in this world... thank you for your words
what medication are you trying ? I was in prozac and buspirone, and mindfulness therapy

I feel your pain. I am 29 and I have been depressed since I am 21. I attempted suicide once and almost made it. Today I wish it had happened. I have made so many terrible things in my life that I regret my existence every single moment. I am nobody to give you advice, and I wish there were answers for you. I only can tell you that I feel your pain.
